base_power.description: Reference base power (wiki basepower, Crystal basePower); a formula input, not a damage value.

cooldown_ms.description: Source cooldown in milliseconds. Zero means no registrar cooldown; custom callbacks may enforce separate reuse. Candidate schema support does not establish native zero-cooldown consumption.

elemental_cast_type.description: Canary spell:element accepted CombatType; used for createElementalSpellCastSnapshot and commit on successful cast. This is source registrar element, not replacement for every Effect damage type; no native consumption claimed.

groups.description: S9: primary group first, then an optional secondary group; group keys differ.

harmony_cost.description: Crystal spell:harmony: when true, successful postCastSpell resets all player Harmony to zero. Distinct from Canary builder/spender harmony_role; no native consumption claimed.

harmony_role.description: S26: the monk Harmony role (Canary monkSpellType): a builder adds Harmony, a spender consumes it. Only monk vocations may carry this role; casting requires the runtime to supply the owning Harmony state.

library_text.description: S19: the official spell library text (Cyclopedia Magical Archive, tibia.com library), verbatim; optional.

needs_shield.description: S27 D.4: the caster must wield a shield in the left or right hand ("You need to equip a shield to cast this spell."); absent means false.

reference_rune_item_id.description: Source numeric runeId retained independently of a qualified ItemRef. Does not supply Item authority, provider revision or native activation.

reference_spell_id.description: Client spell id (Canary/Crystal spell:id, wiki spellid).

learning_required.description: S10/S16: false since patch 15.22 (spells unlock at their level); learned spells are Character state.

level.description: Required character level; 0 = none (monk starter spells).

vocation_display_flags.description: Source vocation registrar description flags, distinct from cast eligibility. Preserves source argument order; candidate data support does not establish native consumption.

wheel_unlock.description: S6/S16: a Wheel of Destiny revelation spell; not castable until a Wheel owner exists (fails closed).

stance_slot.description: Canary spell:stance accepted instant spell stance slot. Successful cast toggles stance by spell id; no native consumption claimed.

aim_at_target.description: S20: a direction spell the player may set to turn towards the attacked creature before casting (client "Aim at Target"; BR aimattarget).

allowed_targets.description: S27 D.3 and B.5: who a single-target cast may be aimed at; absent means any. self_or_own_summons: the caster or a creature the caster summoned or convinced (healing runes). not_self: any creature but the caster (Nature's Embrace); needs a target and no self target. allow_on_self false means not_self.

block_walls.description: The cast needs a clear line of sight (Canary/Crystal blockWalls = checkLineOfSight, engine default true).

cast_at_position.description: Source needPosition/optionalTarget flag. Retained independently of needs_target; owning engine selects the variant route and an executor must reproduce its precedence.

words.description: Spoken words, lowercase; required for instant spells.

title: Closed source equipment parameter contract candidates; consumer pending
